history.summary: A 1,216 sqft freehold 3BR at Changi Green (D16, 2001) at $1.6M / $1,316 PSF — right at the project's $1,323.5 URA median and backed by a solid 45-txn series showing 4.64%/yr appreciation. Fairly-priced, well-supported, with Upper Changi DTL MRT 570m away and Bayshore/CAG growth in the district.
history.rating_rationale: This is the cleanest data set in the batch: 45 URA transactions (high confidence), 4.64%/yr resale appreciation (healthy for OCR/D16), and the $1,316 PSF listing is essentially at the $1,323.5 median — fair value, no overpricing. $1.6M for a freehold 1,216 sqft 3BR is a liquid, deep-buyer-pool quantum, 570m to Upper Changi DTL MRT, and the district benefits from the Bayshore precinct and Changi Airport/aviation-park expansion. Solid, well-evidenced fundamentals with minor age concern only.
